owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other. The black and transparent-sidewall versions count as the same tire.

reports.summary: Replaced the same tires on a classic racer; durability and grip are fine, though the bead is tight at first.
No issues on long, fast rides.
Fine so far after a month, but heavier than the bike's original tires and the owner is unsure they roll as well.
Easy to install and feels good on the road.
A big improvement on the stock tires: fast rolling, grippy and no puncture in 200 miles.
Back to the Pro One after punctures with another brand: grippy, fast and no punctures so far.
The owner's favourite tire: rolls well with adequate puncture protection, and with a TPU tube it is lighter than most tubeless setups.
No flat in over 4,000 km and more than a year, partly on gravel.
Very tough, with good grip on wet ground.
Two seasons and about 10,000 km, partly on gravel, without a single flat and always with grip.
Five months and 2,000 km on very mixed roads and light gravel, dry and wet: very supple and secure, with no cuts, cracks or flats.
